svg.title: A task in the dark
svg.desc: Make the active task a small, specific obligation inside a much larger indifferent facility. One selected rack and one highlighted objective establish a run, not a machine character. Receding windowless equipment bays establish facility scale around the separately highlighted rack.

**Action:** An evaluation run begins.
